description: Fires when column 2 (third from left) has three same-colour stones stacked on top with the cell above empty, i.e. a vertical four-threat in column 2; very strong (20-85) when the three is the opponent's (a must-block), moderate (5-10) when it is mine. Same pattern in other columns does not fire (cols 0/1 only weakly). Also fires weakly when the opponent just played column 2 and its landing cell is a must-block in another direction.
effect: Pushes the move to column 2: forcing it high sends column 2 to ~100% probability even where the model preferred column 3; zeroing it where it naturally fires changes nothing (the block is already certain).
notes: p1 (vertical three on top of col 2, either side): F1 0.433 P 0.96 R 0.28. +any col-2 landing threat: 0.484. +vertical threes cols 0/1: 0.461. p4 (+opp must-block at col-2 landing when last move col 2): F1 0.536 P 0.73 R 0.43 (best). +fresh opp threes cols 0/1: 0.499. Minimal pairs: same opening three in cols 0,1,3,4,5,6 gives 2.0,0.3,0,0.3,0,0; blocking the three or a full column kills it; horizontal row-0 threat at col 2 does nothing. About half of firing is weak (0.87-3) and diffuse, not captured. Simulation share reported nan (perfect-reader ceiling negative). Synthesis max 66 < dev max 84.
